roadmap.goal: Transform Thai education through AP, teacher development, shared services, integrated ERP, and a scalable boarding-school and shopping-mall campus.

vision.title: One school. One direction.
vision.mission: Cultivate young global leaders through industry-driven, innovative learning. Develop knowledge, skills, and character so students can create positive change.

pillars.title: American curriculum & AP
pillars.detail: American Common Core, an Advanced Placement pathway, university preparation, and global university connections.

pillars.title: Disruptive thinking pedagogy
pillars.detail: Real-world problems, project-based STEM, digital and AI literacy, and student-centered inquiry.

pillars.title: Confident voices, global connections
pillars.detail: English, Chinese, Spanish, and Thai for academic success, global connection, and cultural identity.

streams.goal: A KKU educational facility that develops and supplies teachers for the learning model.

streams.goal: A central kitchen that supports the school ecosystem as it grows.

streams.name: 4. All ERP

streams.goal: An integrated ERP across the education ecosystem and its operations.

streams.name: 5. Boarding school & shopping mall
streams.next: Define how the boarding school and shopping mall support the education vision and the expansion model.
streams.goal: Build and scale the boarding-school and shopping-mall campus around the transformed education model.
